_meta.shows: Three launched craft below the pads: the LFV-2 Wave and the Wave Probe with their part trees heard, and Kerbin Relay A never heard from.
_meta.notes: Each part tree is the one `trackingStation.vessel.<guid>.parts` carries, built from the Ship Map's own LFV-2 Wave and Wave Probe captures with the live fields (temperatures, flows, module states) left out as an unloaded craft sends them. The relay has no parts emit, so picking it draws the absence dash. At 9 columns by 12 rows and up the first craft is picked and its side view drawn beside the list; below that the widget is as it was.
